mods.name: Currents of Trade
mods.description:
Expand your horizons with oceanic commerce! Currents of Trade introduces seafaring trade routes, harbor economics, and maritime ventures to Minecraft.

Features:
• Anchor Points & Harbors: Establish coastal trading ports and link distant harbors across the world.
• Autonomous Cargo & Trade Ships: Send resources or dispatch trade orders across oceans with smart island circumnavigation.
• Sloop Sailing: Pilot your own multi-part vessel with realistic buoyancy and dynamic seafaring physics.
• Harbormaster Profession & Village Docks: Discover naturally generating coastal docks and trade with skilled Harbormasters.
• Maritime Commodities & Currencies: Trade Doubloons, Silk, Fine Porcelain, Tea, Amber Vials, Spices, and more!
• Harbor Specializations & Naval Gear: Specialize ports into Free Ports, Naval Drydocks, or Guild Depots, mount Brass Swivel Harpoons, blow the Bosun's Whistle, scout with the Captain's Spyglass, and browse all routes in JEI!
• Wandering Sailors & Sunken Relics: Uncover messages in bottles, treasure charts, guild charters, and rare nautical curiosities.

releases.notes:
# Currents of Trade v1.0.7

### ⚓ New Features
- **Harbor Specializations (Lv. 3+):** Specialize upgraded Anchor Points into **Free Port** (+25% Doubloon payouts, -25% shipping fees), **Royal Drydock** (+20% ship speed, reinforced hulls, -50% cooldowns, passive dock repair), or **Guild Depot** (2nd Daily Urgent Bounty, 8x4x8 warehouse scan, +9 cargo slots).
- **Sealed Trade Charters & Guild Strongboxes:** Fulfill regional merchant contracts at matching harbors or via Trade/Cargo Ships to earn Doubloons, XP, and treasure-filled **Guild Strongboxes**.
- **Captain's Brass Spyglass:** 2.8x naval scope with a live Recon HUD showing ship status, harbor details, and regional trade demands.
- **Bosun's Whistle:** Summon nearby Sloops/Cargo Ships to shore or recall outbound autonomous Trade Ships.
- **Brass Swivel Harpoon:** Bow-mounted ship turret that automatically fires at nearby hostile aquatic mobs.

### 🛠️ Improvements & QoL
- **Persistent Anchor Points:** Breaking an upgraded, specialized, or renamed Anchor Point now keeps all harbor data on the dropped item.
- **Recipe Book & JEI:** Added 13 vanilla Recipe Book unlock advancements and 8 new JEI info pages.
- **Localization & Tooltips:** Full 4-language parity (en_us, 	r_tr, de_de,  r_fr) and updated item ability tooltips.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed Wandering Sailor Merchant Ships spawning submerged underwater or inside covered boathouses/small ponds.
- Fixed normal right-clicking an Anchor Point with a Nautical Chart, Route Journal, or Trade Ledger opening the GUI instead of binding/recording.
- Fixed Anchor Point button tooltips clipping off the top of the screen and NauticalAtlasScreen pin click offsets/blur.
- Fixed First Chart, Fair Winds, Sealed in Wax, and Whispers from the Deep advancements triggering too early.
- Fixed Hopper extraction on outbound Trade Ships, chart-swapping in RequestTradeMenu, and waterless harbor bounty exploits.

---

### 📋 Changelog (v1.0.5 → v1.0.6)

- Added the interactive **Nautical Atlas** GUI with three comprehensive tabs: World Maritime Map, live Regional Trade Ledger with arbitrage pricing, and Route Catalog.
- Added 3 new exotic trade commodities with unique active mechanics and regional market pricing:
  - **Dragon's Blood Resin**: Consumable resin granting Fire Resistance (60s) & Strength I (30s), or dyes ship sails deep crimson.
  - **Frankincense Tears**: Consumable aromatherapy incense restoring 4 Hunger + 8 Saturation, cleansing negative status effects, and granting Regeneration II (10s) and Haste I (45s).
  - **Royal Tyrian Dye**: Rare dye imparting imperial Tyrian purple coloration to Sloop and Cargo Boat sails.
- Added full Shipwright customization support to **Cargo Boats** (matching the Sloop): 16 dye colors + Tyrian Purple + Dragon's Blood Red, Stern-mounted Banners, Bow Lanterns / Soul Lanterns, and Copper Hull Sheathing (+15% speed, -50% hull damage).
- Added Redstone Automation to Harbor Logistics:
  - Anchor Points emit a redstone comparator signal (1–15) proportional to harbor storage fullness.
  - Applying a redstone pulse or continuous signal to an Anchor Point automatically triggers instant cargo unloading from docked ships into adjacent chests/barrels.
  - Added an interactive **⚓ Unload Depot** button directly inside the Anchor Point GUI.
- Added 6 specialized **Maritime Trade Leagues** to Wandering Sailor spawn tables with authentic regional rosters (Amber Route, Spice Fleet, Pearl Coast, Northern Whalers, Silk Guild, and Mediterranean Cogs).
- Added complete **German (de_de.json)** and **French ( r_fr.json)** translations with 100% key parity across all 4 languages.
- Added full **JEI (Just Enough Items)** integration showcasing maritime trade exchange tables, harbor offers, and Wandering Sailor trade rosters.
- Fixed ships hugging river shorelines and shallow banks by implementing Thalweg river-centerline navigation and deep-water corridor clearance biasing.
- Fixed false-positive voyage cancellations when arriving near harbor terminals by expanding final docking radius and adding multi-stage approach tolerance.
- Fixed Port Journal retaining destroyed or removed harbor anchor points by adding automatic validation and ghost harbor cleanup upon opening the journal.
- Fixed visual centering offsets for Frankincense Tears and Royal Tyrian Dye 2D item textures.
- Fixed missing translation key for Dragon's Blood Resin market tooltip (	ooltip.currents_of_trade.commodity.dragons_blood_resin.markets).
- Removed outdated route entries and stale cached path nodes upon harbor relocation or deconstruction.

---

### 📋 Changelog (v1.0.4 → v1.0.5)

- Added a two-level incremental water route planner (bidirectional coarse chunk-component A* + fine 2-block-grid A*) with shared per-tick CPU time budgeting (4ms per ship / 8ms total) for long-range lag-free navigation.
- Added pre-dispatch port water connectivity verification (VerifyPortWaterConnection) so ships refuse to depart when no navigable water route exists between harbors.
- Added intermediate sea waypoint plotting to Nautical Charts (up to 8 waypoints per chart via Right-Click at sea or aboard a ship, Sneak+Right-Click to clear) with glowing beacon particle indicators.
- Added 5 new biome-specialized exotic trade commodities with unique buffs and regional arbitrage pricing: Saffron Bundle, Narwhal Ivory, Jade Figurine, Cacao Elixir, and Damascus Steel Ingot.
- Added automatic harbor depot cargo unloading upon ship arrival into chests, barrels, hoppers, and modded storage containers adjacent to an Anchor Point (excluding Ender Chests).
- Added a manual ⚓ Unload button to the ship cargo GUI (ChestScreen) to transfer all cargo from a docked Sloop, Cargo Ship, or Trade Ship into adjacent harbor storage with one click.
- Added a ↻ Repeat button to the Request Trade screen to automatically restage the last dispatched trade order at that harbor using items from the player's inventory.
- Added a 27-slot Captain's Hold inventory to the player-controlled Sloop (opened via Sneak+Right-Click) that retains its contents when the Sloop is picked up as an item.
- Added Sloop Shipwright customization supporting 16 sail dye colors (washable with Water Bucket or Sponge), mountable Heraldic Banners on the main sail, mountable Bow Lanterns / Soul Lanterns with dynamic light emission, and Copper Hull Sheathing (+15% cruising speed and -50% hull damage).
- Added 4 new maritime advancements: *Master Cartographer*, *Weather Prophet*, *Dressed to Sail*, and *Pride of the Armada*.
- Added a 100 HP breakable hull system to autonomous in-transit ships (with 2x Axe salvage damage and passive regeneration) so players can break obstructed ships.
- Added the enableFastTravelBoats server configuration option to allow server admins to disable fast-travel passenger voyages.
- Fixed ships entering dead-end bays, coves, and closed river arms by restricting fine A* pathfinding to verified coarse water corridor components.
- Fixed ships attempting to cross 1-block land barriers, narrow dams, and diagonal shoreline corners by enforcing 2x2 hull water footprints and strict 0.35-block water edge sampling.
- Fixed mid-voyage canal closures (including WorldEdit //set and block placement) causing ships to wander through every nearby waterway instead of immediately halting and cancelling the voyage (or returning cargo to the home harbor).
- Fixed shoreline-hugging at harbor departure and arrival by introducing multi-ring water clearance scoring ( indBestHarborWaterSpawn), Thalweg river-centerline smoothing, and two-stage harbor docking approaches.
- Fixed fast-travel passenger voyages using the Trade Ship appearance and name instead of the standard Sloop model, texture, and name.
- Fixed autonomous ships being pushed back by vanilla boat wave physics or colliding with their own ShipPart multipart hitboxes.
